title: Get Shooting Working End to End After Documentapp Configview
description: Shooting UI fails to compile after DocumentApp ConfigView &self migration: apply_config_bytes wants &self; runtime mutations need RefCell interior mutability (same pattern as procedural 3d).
summary: Fixed shooting end-to-end after DocumentApp ConfigView migration. (1) Wrapped ShootingPlayApp runtime/config in RefCell so &self DocumentApp methods can mutate ephemeral state; fixed typed-channel tests for ConfigView. (2) Synced TS AppChannel codec to Rust CHANNEL_VERSION=3: ConfigCommand/LoadConfig/ReadConfig command tags, Config/ConfigChanged frame tags, shifted ContextMenu/Media/Error tags, updated goldens. (3) handle_typed_command now returns None for non-op-binary frames so legacy {kind,name,args} envelopes (setActiveExample, registerBrushMesh) fall through instead of failing as unsupported op format. Verified: cargo test -p semio-s-app-shooting-ui --lib 28 passed; wasm plugin builds; Playwright against http://127.0.0.1:6019 shows Scene+Icon chrome, 1 canvas, /mesh/🧊️base.glb as glTF, zero console/page errors.
